title: I found out what to do with the Godot Multiplayer Project!
content:
So I did a thing...

Ok yes, you read the title of the post, I did it. It kinda works right now, at the computer science club meet it wasn't wanting to work across computers but maybe that was the district. It definetly needs further testing and development. I'm currently trying to get Henry to make the assets for this project so I can make it look better but I don't know if I want to continually work on a singular project for days on end. I like when I can think of cool additions to a project without having to worry about finding time to work on it, it gives me time to think of good implementation. That's kinda whats also happening with this website too. I don't know, but feel free to take a look at the game.

![the current game look](./assets/sticks_game_01.png)

You can find it in the "current projects" tab or you can just click the link right [here](https://github.com/withereddetective/godot-online-sticks-game). Its mostly the same low level networking code as before, I don't feel like giving a huge breakdown of it right here. Perhapds when I finish a project I'll make a whole post breaking down how it works. Anyhow, I will begin work on the face constructor again and I will hopefully finish it soon.

Unfortunate news from the Seguin Computer Science club, we will not actually do the Godot Wild Game Jam 99, none of us did any work yet so we vowed to actually do it next month.

But to end off on a good note, check out this game Henry made!

![Henry's game](./assets/henry_game_01.png)

He's been working on it on and off for a while now, its inspired heavily be Undertale and Deltarune but it has quite a few changes to stand out as well as his own cool artstyle! He wanted me to advertise it so I hope this is worth it! He's starting to do more projects so that's really nice. You can check it out right [here](https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/1210001511).

In other news, I am just on the cusp of getting my Eagle Rank! That's been taking a lot of my time... Anyways, thats all I have for now! Keep interacting with the blog! I'll respond whenever someone comments!

-Withered Detective

title: Addition to the First Big Update
content:
So I have just been having too much fun working on this website. I have been adding even more features such as:

- The ability to minimize and maximize posts
- A spinning donut in the top left corner of the page
- A whiteboard that says random messages when you click it

I will keep making new posts and I will respond to comments as much as I can, although I will refrain from just saying thank you to "oh this is so cool!!!1!" comments. However, I will pause on the updates to the site for now, I have other projects that I also want to continue working on, check the 'current projects' tab for that.

I would like to say one more thing though, please start commenting on literally any post besides the oldest one. Feel free to leave comments or suggestions on other posts too! Use this post for any issues or suggestions you want to bring up before the next big update!

But anyways, thank you for using this site.

-Withered Detective

title: First Big Update!
content:
This is the first big update to the site! I have added a few new features, including:

- The ability to lock comments on posts
- Audio credits for posts with audio
- A new plant that can be watered!
- Logging the amount of visits

Please try not to spam reload or spam the plant, while yes it is very hard to max out the use of firebase, it is nowhere near impossible. I hope this post is a good example of some of the newly added features.

I will continue to add more features as I think of them, and I will continue to post regularly.

-Withered Detective

title: We did the NASA Space Apps Challenge!
audioCredits: "Waltz of the Forgotten Man" by Toby Fox
content:
The team did the NASA Space Apps Challenge yesterday! I am so proud of our team and how productive we were!

![the team again](./assets/hack_team.jpg)

Our project is called **"Missions to Mars"** and you can check it out right [here!](https://github.com/withereddetective/nasa-hackathon)

The repository is public and you can not only check out our work in the Godot engine, but you can also download the compiled build for Windows by clicking the **Releases** tab on the repository page, as seen here:

![github page](./assets/nasa_git_page.png)

We had a lot of fun and I can't wait to do more hackathons with this team in the future! We are starting the Godot Wild Jam 99 this next week, and I cannot wait to see what this team can do with even more time on our hands!

-Withered Detective

Edit: I added the part at the end about the Godot Wild Jam 99, I forgot to mention it in the original post.

title: Look at the Seguin Computer Science Club!
content:
Its the computer science team at my school! (Well, except for Vincent) These guys are the best! Just wanted to show them off.

![the team](./assets/20261112_152854.jpg)

**Me**- Bottom Left

**Zak**- Above me, not really the best at computer science but he can light up the room!

**Henry**- Above Zak, pretty novice with computers but realy good at art and super friendly!

**Xander**- Next to Zak, very close friend, he is very talented and I am always inspired by what he does! he even has his own portfolio website right [here!](https://realprot0n.github.io/)

**Michael**- Above Xander, super smart! He is learning computer science very quickly, I am very invested in his journey! He impresses in everything he does.

**Mr. Schramm**- Top right corner, he's kinda just been along for the ride, but he's been a very good sponsor and coach!

**Vincent**- Not here, he's only recently found out that he wants to do web development with his life and he's been making great progress! He's also very cool to talk and play games with.

So yeah, thats the club! They are all very great and I couldn't have wished for a better team to have!

-Withered Detective
